client-guidelines:
Updated for 2026 Collaboration Standards • Anicomic International • Kraftor

1. Project Kickoff & Asset Submission

To ensure production starts without delay and meets the highest photorealistic benchmark, please provide the following source materials at kickoff:

  • Architectural / Product Drawings: CAD (.dwg), Revit (.rvt), SketchUp (.skp), Rhino (.3dm), or 3D OBJ/FBX files.
  • Material & Finish Schedule: High-resolution swatches, moodboards, paint codes, or vendor catalogs.
  • Lighting & Mood References: Preferred daylight scenarios, golden hour, twilight, or dramatic studio illumination.
  • Camera Perspectives: Site survey photos, drone footage, or indicated viewing angles on floor plans.

2. Review Cycles & Milestones

We utilize a structured 3-phase review process so your vision is dialed in methodically before committing to high-resolution final rendering:

  • Milestone 1 — Camera & Geometry Approval: Clay/grey renders demonstrating composition, proportions, and viewpoint.
  • Milestone 2 — Shading & Lighting Preview: Texture mappings, reflectivity, foliage, and ambient lighting sign-off.
  • Milestone 3 — Final Render & Grade: Master high-resolution stills or animated sequence deliverable.

3. Communication & Turnaround Times

Our dedicated project managers maintain real-time updates via WhatsApp, Slack, or Email. Standard draft reviews receive turnaround within 24–48 business hours. We recommend consolidating feedback into a single annotated document or markup to keep project velocity at its peak.

4. Deliverable Formats & Archive Access

Final outputs are delivered in ultra-high resolution across standard modern formats:

  • Stills: 4K / 8K TIFF, PNG (with alpha channels where requested), and web-optimized JPEG.
  • Animations: 4K UHD ProRes 422 or H.265 / MP4 at 30/60 fps.
  • Interactive Assets: 360° panoramic tours, GLTF/GLB web models.

All finalized assets remain securely archived in our private cloud storage for 12 months for easy re-access and scaling.
employee-guidelines:
Internal Culture & Production Code • Anicomic International Family

1. The Kraftor Philosophy: Uncompromising Craft

At Kraftor, every pixel, shader, keyframe, and lighting bounce reflects our dedication to artistic mastery and technical discipline. We do not ship "good enough"—we strive for visual storytelling that captivates, moves, and inspires.

  • Obsession with Detail: Pay rigorous attention to real-world scale, material roughness, specular roll-offs, and lens optics.
  • Continuous Learning: Stay at the vanguard of real-time engines (Unreal Engine 5), generative AI workflows, procedural modeling, and GPU acceleration.
  • Collaborative Ownership: Take pride in collective output; provide actionable feedback and support fellow artists generously.

2. Production Pipeline & File Hygiene

Efficiency and teamwork depend on standardized repository architecture and naming taxonomy across all software tools (Blender, 3ds Max, Maya, Houdini, After Effects):

  • Standard Naming: PROJECT_SCENE_SHOT_v001.[ext]. Never use "final_final" or "test_new".
  • Asset Organization: Textures must be linked via relative paths under dedicated project asset folders with ACES/sRGB color space metadata.
  • Version Control: Check in work daily before end of shift with concise changelog notes.

3. Client Confidentiality & Security Protocol

Team members frequently handle unreleased intellectual property, prototype hardware, and confidential architectural schemes:

  • No screenshots, work-in-progress reels, or client assets may be posted to personal social media (Instagram, ArtStation, YouTube) prior to official client public launch and written management approval.
  • Studio credentials, private cloud buckets, and internal drive keys must remain safeguarded with multi-factor authentication.

4. Growth, Culture & Careers

We believe our team is our ultimate superpower. We nurture growth through masterclasses, equipment upgrades, flexible remote-hybrid setups, and quarterly skill assessments. Interested in expanding into a lead or supervisory role? Talk to your creative director or explore open requisitions via our Careers Portal.

1. Overview & Acceptance

These Terms & Conditions govern the provision of 3D visualization, architectural rendering, CGI animation, and creative design services provided by Kraftor (a division of Anicomic International). By accessing our website, engaging our services, or commissioning a project, you agree to comply with and be bound by these terms.

2. Project Quotations & Milestones

All quotations provided by Kraftor are valid for 30 calendar days from the date of issue unless otherwise specified in writing. Project milestones are established upon receipt of initial deposit and requisite reference files (CAD drawings, 3D models, brand guidelines).

  • Phase 1 (Blockout & Camera Angles): Review of base geometry, composition, and perspectives.
  • Phase 2 (Materials & Lighting): Texturing, illumination, and atmosphere approval.
  • Phase 3 (Final Rendering & Post-Production): High-resolution export and delivery.

3. Revisions & Scope Adjustments

Every commissioned project includes designated revision rounds as detailed in the agreed proposal. Revisions encompass adjustments to materials, lighting parameters, and minor camera offsets within the agreed design scope.

Substantive structural modifications or redesigns requested subsequent to milestone approvals will be estimated separately as scope adjustments.

4. Intellectual Property & Usage Rights

Upon receipt of full and final payment, the client is granted an exclusive, perpetual license for the commercial or personal use of the finalized visual assets as specified in the service agreement.

Anicomic International and Kraftor retain the right to showcase approved renderings, animations, and non-confidential project highlights within our portfolio, website, and promotional reels.

5. Confidentiality & Data Protection

We treat all proprietary architectural blueprints, unreleased product designs, and client communications under strict non-disclosure safeguards. We never sell, transfer, or disclose sensitive client data to unauthorized third parties.

6. Governing Law & Contact

These terms shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of Maharashtra, India. For questions or legal clarifications, please reach us at info@kraftor.in.
